text.Помогать увидеть свою ценность, заявить: Helping people see their value, speak up for themselves and step out to others more boldly.

text.Три ведущие открывают день общей историе: The three hosts open the day with a shared story of unity. Through a gentle practice of attention and movement, we restore contact with ourselves. In pairs we say: “What did I come with? What is my strength? What am I ready for?”
text.Результат: личное намерение на день и пе: Result: a personal intention for the day and a first introduction without formal business cards.

text.Результат: одна цель на 2027 год, своя з: Result: one goal for 2027, your own zone of strength and a request to future partners.

text.Готовим короткое видео-знакомство или ан: We prepare a short introduction video or an announcement of an idea. In mini-groups we film on our phones: who we are, what unites us and whom we invite. You can choose a photo with text or stay off camera. Publication and tags are optional and by mutual consent.
text.Результат: материал для публикации и пон: Result: material for publication and a clear joint call to the audience.
text.Команды размещают свои проекты в общей г: Teams place their projects in a shared gallery. Participants get to know them and leave offers of help and contacts, by consent. We look at a few ideas together with the hosts: what to strengthen and how to start with the resources available.
text.Результат: обратная связь, новые точки с: Result: feedback, new points of collaboration and a clarified next step.
text.Каждая фиксирует действие на ближайшие 7: Each person records an action for the next 72 hours. Partners confirm the date of the first call and how to stay in touch. We close the day with a shared circle: “What am I taking with me, and what am I ready to create together?”
text.Результат: личный шаг, первая договорённ: Result: a personal step, a first agreement and a sense of belonging to a shared movement.
text.Цель на 2027 год и понимание, с какими л: A goal for 2027 and an understanding of which people and resources to move towards it with.
text.Слова, чтобы заявить о себе: Words to speak up for yourself
text.Короткая самопрезентация и предложение,: A short self-presentation and an offer that is easy to put to a future partner.
text.Карта контактов, черновик коллаборации и: A contact map, a draft collaboration and an agreement for the next meeting.
text.Контент-материал, поддержка новых знаком: Content material, the support of new acquaintances and an action for the next 72 hours.
text.Наше намерение на 2027 год — соединять л: Our intention for 2027 is to connect people, cities and countries through joint projects.
text.Этот день — приглашение стать частью так: This day is an invitation to become part of such a movement.
text.Если я никого не знаю и мне сложно знако: What if I don't know anyone and find it hard to meet people?
text.Знакомства встроены в программу: будут в: Introductions are built into the programme: there will be questions, small groups and time to settle in. You choose what to share and which activities to take part in.
text.Нужен ли готовый проект или большая ауди: Do I need a ready project or a large audience?
text.Достаточно идеи, опыта или желания найти: An idea, experience or a wish to find a direction is enough. For a joint project, different strengths are useful: knowledge, creativity, organisation and the ability to connect people.
text.Телефон с зарядкой, блокнот и одну идею,: A phone with a charger, a notebook and one idea you want to develop. If you have links to your projects, save them to exchange contacts.
text.Когда, где и сколько стоит участие?: When, where and how much does participation cost?
text.Второй день фестиваля «Звёздный час» про: The second day of the “Star Hour” festival will take place in Luxembourg. The date, address, start time and price will be added once confirmed by the organisers.

text.Настоящая политика объясняет, какие перс: This policy explains what personal data we collect on the luxembourgfestival.com website (the international “Star Hour” festival, Luxembourg), why we do so and what rights you have. We process data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679).
text.1. Кто отвечает за ваши данные: 1. Who is responsible for your data
text.Оператором данных являются организаторы: The data controller is the organising team of the “Star Hour” festival. For any questions about personal data, write to
text.Анкета тренера (форма «Стать тренером»):: Trainer application form (the “Become a trainer” form):
text.платёж проходит на защищённой странице п: payment is made on the secure page of the Stripe payment service. We do not receive or store your bank card details or other payment details. We only receive the information needed to confirm payment (for example, name, email address, amount and payment status).
text.после оплаты билета мы создаём электронн: after a ticket is paid for, we create an electronic ticket and store in a database: the buyer's name, email address, the unique ticket number (also encoded in the QR code), the Stripe payment identifier, and the date and time the ticket was created and sent. If you bought several tickets, each one carries the buyer's name. At the festival entrance a team member scans the ticket's QR code; we record that the ticket has been used and the time of entry. No photos or videos are recorded during scanning.
text.если вы пишете нам на info@luxembourgfes: if you write to us at info@luxembourgfestival.com, we receive your address and the content of your message.
text.3. Для чего мы используем данные и на ка: 3. Why we use the data and on what basis
text.Рассмотрение заявки и связь с вами: Reviewing your application and contacting you
text.— для того, чтобы связаться с вами по по: — to contact you about taking part in the festival (your consent and steps taken at your request before entering into a contract).
text.Оформление участия, оплата и выдача биле: Registering participation, payment and issuing tickets
text.— исполнение договора и выполнение юриди: — performance of a contract and compliance with legal obligations (accounting).
text.Отправка билета по электронной почте и к: Sending the ticket by email and entry control
text.(проверка подлинности билета, защита от: (checking the ticket's authenticity, protection against reuse and forgery, counting guests) — performance of a contract and our legitimate interest in organising the event safely.
text.— наш законный интерес в общении с посет: — our legitimate interest in communicating with visitors to the site.
text.Мы не продаём ваши данные и не используе: We do not sell your data and do not use it for automated decision-making.
text.(Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., Ирландия): (Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., Ireland) — payment processing, including by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Revolut Pay. Stripe processes data under its own privacy policy.
text.(Aruba) — хранение сайта, базы данных с: (Aruba) — hosting of the site and the ticket database, and email processing (including sending tickets).
text.(сервис защиты форм от роботов Turnstile: (the Turnstile bot-protection service for forms) — when you submit a form, your browser sends Cloudflare technical data (for example, the IP address) to check that a human is filling in the form.
text.Члены команды организаторов, которым эти: Members of the organising team who need this data to handle your application.
text.Государственные органы — только если это: Public authorities — only if required by law.
text.Для отображения сайта подгружаются шрифт: To display the site, Google Fonts are loaded, and the OpenStreetMap map is loaded in the geography section. When these elements load, your browser sends the services technical data, such as the IP address. By default the site does not use advertising or analytics cookies. If we enable visit statistics (Google Analytics) or advertising tools (Meta Pixel — Facebook and Instagram), they will be enabled only after your consent in the cookie window. You can decline or change your choice at any time with the “Cookie settings” button at the bottom of the page. In that case, visit data (IP address, device type, pages viewed) may be sent to Google and Meta; their privacy policies apply separately.
text.Мы храним данные не дольше, чем это необ: We keep data no longer than necessary for the purposes stated above or as required by law. Application data for which no participation decision was made is deleted at your request. Ticket data (name, email address, ticket number, entry record) is kept for no more than 12 months after the festival date, after which it is deleted or anonymised; payment information that we are legally required to keep (accounting) is kept for the periods set by law.

text.Чтобы воспользоваться правами, напишите: To exercise your rights, write to
. We will reply within one month.
text.Вы также можете подать жалобу в надзорны: You can also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. In Luxembourg this is the National Commission for Data Protection (CNPD),
text.Мы принимаем разумные технические и орга: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data against loss, unauthorised access and disclosure: the connection to the site is secure (HTTPS), only the organising team has password-protected access to the ticket list and scanning, and Stripe messages are verified by digital signature.
text.Мы можем обновлять эту политику. Актуаль: We may update this policy. The current version is always published on this page, and the date of the last update is shown at the top.
